title: Quality Manager
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

  • 20+ R&D and operations centers
  • 50+ manufacturing bases
  • 80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally
  • 10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity
  • Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms
  • Over 50% international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

1. Development of the Quality Management System (QMS):

Develop, implement, and maintain a robust QMS for the project.

Define quality standards, procedures, and guidelines aligned with project requirements and organizational goals.

2. Quality Planning:

Collaborate with the Project Manager to develop quality plans for each phase of the project.

Establish key quality management performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and monitor project quality.

3. Quality Assurance:

Conduct regular quality assurance audits to ensure compliance with established standards and procedures.

Identify areas for improvement and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of all quality-related activities.

Prepare regular reports on quality performance and present results to project stakeholders.

description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.


The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.

  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.

  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.


Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.

Somos uma empresa pertencente a multinacional inglesa ABF - Associated British Foods, que está presente em 48 países estamos entre as cinco principais empresas de alimentos do mundo. Nosso time está com mais de 800 funcionários e nossas fábricas e escritórios estão localizados no estado de São Paulo com força de vendas em todo território nacional. Atuamos com fermento e ingredientes para panificação e confeitaria com as marcas Fleischmann, Mauri, Gran Finale, Sohovos, Ovomaltine, Twinings, Danke e Amigos do Bem.


A AB Mauri está em uma jornada de transformação e crescimento, e acreditamos que nossa conexão é mais forte do que qualquer diferença que venha a nos dividir. Venha ser diverso conosco, faça parte do nosso time!



O que esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Administração de Vendas, Sales Operations ou áreas comerciais, preferencialmente em empresas de alimentos, food service ou bens de consumo.
  • Experiência com gestão e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Vivência com análise de indicadores comerciais, gestão de processos e melhoria contínua.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e sistemas de gestão (ERP - SAP, CRM, Excel ou BI) e boa interface com tecnologia e dados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, com forte habilidade interpessoal, influência e comunicação eficaz com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de identificar problemas e propor soluções.
  • Organização, senso de responsabilidade e alto padrão de ética profissional.



O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderança e gestão da equipe de administração de vendas, garantindo o cumprimento das metas e o desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho da área, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e implementando ações para otimizar os resultados.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da empresa, bem como com as normas e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Planejamento e execução do orçamento da área.
  • Desenvolvimento de políticas e procedimentos para otimização dos processos.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre a equipe de administração de vendas e as demais áreas da empresa (ex: logística, financeiro, marketing), facilitando a comunicação e a resolução de problemas.
  • Treinar e desenvolver a equipe, garantindo que os colaboradores tenham as habilidades e conhecimentos necessários para desempenhar suas funções.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e melhores práticas do mercado, buscando constantemente aprimorar os processos e resultados da área.



Modelo de trabalho:

Para esta vaga estamos aplicando o modelo de trabalho híbrido - nesse modelo você atuará 40% do tempo de forma remota. A definição dos dias que você deverá vir ao escritório é flexível e definida junto com o gestor. Nosso escritório está localizado em São Paulo ao ladinho da estação de metrô de Pinheiros.



Inclusão e Diversidade:

Todas as vagas da AB Mauri estão abertas para aplicação de todas as pessoas. Aqui respeitamos e zelamos muito para um ambiente inclusivo e diverso, sendo assim, sua aplicação é bem-vinda independentemente de suas características ou condições quanto à etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, acessibilidade, cultural, social ou de qualquer outro fator.

title: OLAC Business Development Manager - Sales
description:
Job Description:


Position: OLAC Business Development Manager – Sales


Position Reports to: VP – Marketing LATAM


Department: Marketing


Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil


LifeStyles is seeking for an OLAC Business Development Manager for Sales , based in Brazil, to manage our distributors in the regions and growing our product portfolio, leading the regions through sell in and sell out with the current distributors and further developing new business opportunities.


If you're passionate about disrupting the status quo and driving innovation in the CPG space, this is your chance to make waves in the sexual wellness industry!



Key responsibilities:

  • Own and develop the OLAC region by leading market penetration and becoming the face of the company.
  • Manage and have an overview and understanding of each company business at the Distributors in the countries of Argentina, Chile and Columbia.
  • Develop new distributors and develop new markets in Jamaica, Uruguay, Caribe, Peru, Costa Rica, Ecuador and Panama.
  • Cultivate new customer relationships and maintain a strong focus on current customers through effective use of the sales and service organizations to expand the business.
  • Grows company portfolio through high activity levels, networking, training and qualification of the distributors' team.
  • Manage the full cycle of sales - from prospect to onboarding- and aim to close 3-5 deals in your first 6 months.
  • Partner with internal cross-functional team members (supply, marketing, finance, etc.) to situate your accounts for success and drive account growth.
  • Monitor “Sell in” and “Sell out”, preparing demand update and performance indicators of each country, preparing tactical and strategic action plans for the medium and long term.
  • Development of TOP distributor accounts.
  • Achieve regional sales targets.
  • Daily management of campaigns and promotions with all distributors, tracking investments in A&P and marketing programs.
  • Support leadership to conduct regular presentations to Directors and Senior Leaders within the business on regional distribution, ensuring maintenance of daily management and presentation of activities.
  • Design and implement a process to drive improved integration of distribution management with company, when applicable.
  • Be the interface with the Operations functions for order prioritization.
  • Implement and drive processes to ensure improved management and understanding lead times with our Distributors.
  • Conduct research on market trends and support product launches and networking events.
  • Perform regular inventory checks.
  • Support our distributor network with business agreement and penetration for our NPD and launches.
  • Willing to travel to visit markets when necessary.
  • Other related activities.


Position Requirements

  • Have experience as Business Development professional, with expertise in developing news countries.
  • Bachelor’s degree – Marketing, Business Administration
  • MBA holder will be a plus.
  • Demonstrated organization skills with a successful record to develop a broad set of relationships, to work collaboratively and to succeed in a dynamic and challenging environment
  • Strong resilience, strong interpersonal skills, networking, communication and presentation skills
  • Analytical skills, planning, prioritizing and realizing (mid to long) term goals and needs
  • Native or Advanced Level language skills in Spanish and English.
  • 20 to 30% of international traveling
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and love cross-functional collaboration.
  • Are you a creative problem solver, able to innovate independently and drive impactful results?


Salary range for Base Salary: From R$ 22.000,00 to R$ 27.000,00 per month, according to the candidate experience.

About the Company


LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.


Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.


The LifeStyles family of brands includes the #1 global non-latex condom brand, SKYN®, Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products, under its local heroes such as Mates®, LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control. The brands values are centered around sex positivity, pleasure, confidence and inclusivity.


Outside of branded products, the Company also supports universities, NGOs, and other organizations as part of a broader effort to promote sexual health and prevent the spread of STDs and STIs. LifeStyles owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, India and Spain, and it employs over 1,600 teammates globally.


LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017 , when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.


As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners , a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry.


This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business.


LifeStyles Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.


We are empowered professionals, and we are committed to creating a team of the world’s “best of the best.” Our business foundation is strong, among our values are Integrity and Respect, our people are highly engaged. We have a focus on safety and teamwork - and we want you to join us! If you're looking for a daring opportunity to build brands in this booming & thrilling category, then let's talk.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

description:

#bancocarrefour

A grande missão é analisar dados e encontrar respostas para melhorar a rentabilidade, diminuir custos, aumentar o engajamento e fidelização dos clientes. title: Finance Business Partner (Marketing)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Finance Business Partner to support strategic business initiatives and international expansion. This role will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, ensuring financial rigor while enabling fast, sustainable growth.


You will operate at the intersection of finance and strategy — shaping investment decisions, strengthening financial governance, and delivering insights that directly influence business performance.


This position is ideal for finance professionals who combine strong analytical capabilities with a commercial mindset and thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Financial Partnership: Partner with business leaders across the full financial lifecycle — from planning to execution — providing actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Financial Governance & Process Excellence: Design, implement, and continuously optimize financial processes, policies, and controls to enhance operational efficiency while ensuring compliance.
  • Expansion & Market Launch Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries and cities by establishing scalable frameworks, enabling operational continuity, and proactively managing financial risks.
  • Investment Evaluation & Business Case Development: Assess new business opportunities by evaluating investment requirements, expected returns, and financial viability. Provide clear recommendations to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Ownership: Drive the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure disciplined financial management and strong resource allocation.
  • Advanced Business Analysis: Build robust financial analysis models to monitor performance, identify opportunities, highlight risks, and guide leadership on profitability and cost optimization.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and corporate standards.
  • Finance Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that improve transparency and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Robust experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Solid knowledge of financial regulations within Brazil.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in financial systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience in high-growth industries such as technology, e-commerce, logistics, on-demand platforms, or internet companies .


Why Join Us

  • Be part of a rapidly scaling global business with significant international growth ambitions.
  • Operate as a strategic partner , influencing key investment and operational decisions.
  • Gain broad exposure across financial disciplines while supporting complex, cross-border initiatives.
  • High-impact role with strong visibility among senior stakeholders.

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Executar tarefas de atirador em diversos tipos de armamentos
  • Trabalhar com diferentes tipos de armas
  • Ajuste de tiro e operação de dispositivos de mira
  • Realizar a manutenção e preparo técnico das armas
  • Participar de operações de combate
  • Manter comunicação com o comando e outras unidades para coordenar ações

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Experiência com armamento de Veículo Blindado de Combate à Infantaria (BMP) ou Veículo Blindado de Transporte de Tropas (BTR) será um diferencial
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Boa resistência física e capacidade de trabalhar sob condições extremas
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares
